raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "2.1.1"
  swt_version: "4.37"
  swt_build: "R-4.37-202509050730"
  fluid_soundfont_version: "v3.1"

package:
  name: tuxguitar
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  - url: https://github.com/helge17/tuxguitar/archive/${{ version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: 3077820ffe3865a22d467c13e1191a53b392d4f70c23f6edc44648a9eb8ad355
    target_directory: src

  # Replaces TuxGuitar's bundled default soundfont (MagicSFver2.sf2), whose
  # license was never clearly stated by its author. FluidR3_GM.sf2 is the
  # same soundfont Debian/Ubuntu ship as "fluid-soundfont-gm", licensed MIT
  # by Frank Wen (see LICENSE-FluidR3-MIT.txt).
  - url: https://github.com/pianobooster/fluid-soundfont/releases/download/${{ fluid_soundfont_version }}/FluidR3_GM.sf2
    sha256: 74594e8f4250680adf590507a306655a299935343583256f3b722c48a1bc1cb0
    target_directory: fluid-soundfont

  - if: linux and x86_64
    then:
      url: https://archive.eclipse.org/eclipse/downloads/drops4/${{ swt_build }}/swt-${{ swt_version }}-gtk-linux-x86_64.zip
      sha256: 13ff4f7061078c03e17a2ace3c47931bca34cd5ad17494ee8cfc46780bb057db
      target_directory: swt

  - if: linux and aarch64
    then:
      url: https://archive.eclipse.org/eclipse/downloads/drops4/${{ swt_build }}/swt-${{ swt_version }}-gtk-linux-aarch64.zip
      sha256: e41352cee8753c3afc72c5198abf1397779529557752b276f8bd05c1f0054ae4
      target_directory: swt

  - if: osx and x86_64
    then:
      url: https://archive.eclipse.org/eclipse/downloads/drops4/${{ swt_build }}/swt-${{ swt_version }}-cocoa-macosx-x86_64.zip
      sha256: af56f8116e15c1d70ee3bf4350dc6df27c39b152d5a39d5455be9a881ef1969e
      target_directory: swt

  - if: osx and arm64
    then:
      url: https://archive.eclipse.org/eclipse/downloads/drops4/${{ swt_build }}/swt-${{ swt_version }}-cocoa-macosx-aarch64.zip
      sha256: 48ae185aa03b3f11ed2ca7d8594e0e70098487492f735e60176fe42c6b2a33d1
      target_directory: swt

  - if: win
    then:
      url: https://archive.eclipse.org/eclipse/downloads/drops4/${{ swt_build }}/swt-${{ swt_version }}-win32-win32-x86_64.zip
      sha256: d3782b71dd1595ed042759f7d6a26d577f4f9e45c20ff247f62c119b690e2060
      target_directory: swt

build:
  number: 0

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
    - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
    - if: unix
      then: make
    - openjdk >=17
    - maven >=3.3
  host:
    - if: linux
      then:
        - alsa-lib
        - fluidsynth
        - jack
  run:
    - openjdk >=17
    - menuinst >=2
    - if: linux
      then:
        - alsa-lib
        - fluidsynth
        - jack

tests:
  - script:
      - if: unix
        then: test -x $PREFIX/bin/tuxguitar
      - if: unix
        then: test -f $PREFIX/Menu/tuxguitar_menu.json
      - if: win
        then: if not exist %PREFIX%\Scripts\tuxguitar.bat exit /b 1
      - if: win
        then: if not exist %PREFIX%\Menu\tuxguitar_menu.json exit /b 1

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/helge17/tuxguitar
  repository: https://github.com/helge17/tuxguitar
  summary: Multitrack guitar tablature editor and player
  description: |
    TuxGuitar itself is LGPL-2.1-or-later. The built application also bundles
    several third-party components with their own licenses:
      - Gervill (software MIDI synth): GPL-2.0-only WITH Classpath-exception-2.0
      - Eclipse SWT: EPL-2.0
      - iText 5 (itextpdf, xmlworker, used for PDF export): AGPL-3.0-only
      - Apache Commons Compress / Commons IO: Apache-2.0
      - Breeze / Oxygen / Symbolic icon themes (share/skins): LGPL-3.0-or-later
        (Symbolic is dual LGPL-3.0-or-later / CC-BY-SA-3.0)
    Upstream's bundled default soundfont (MagicSFver2.sf2) has no clearly
    stated license, so this recipe replaces it with FluidR3_GM.sf2 (the same
    soundfont Debian/Ubuntu ship as "fluid-soundfont-gm"), which is MIT
    licensed by Frank Wen.
  # Combined SPDX expression covering the main project license plus every
  # bundled third-party component (see `description` above for details).
  license: LGPL-2.1-or-later AND (GPL-2.0-only WITH Classpath-exception-2.0) AND EPL-2.0 AND AGPL-3.0-only AND Apache-2.0 AND LGPL-3.0-or-later AND CC-BY-SA-3.0 AND MIT
  license_file:
    - src/docs/LICENSE
    - src/desktop/gervill/LICENSE
    - LICENSE-EPL-2.0.txt
    - LICENSE-AGPL-3.0.txt
    - LICENSE-Apache-2.0.txt
    - LICENSE-LGPL-3.0.txt
    - LICENSE-CC-BY-SA-3.0.txt
    - LICENSE-FluidR3-MIT.txt

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - travishathaway
